title: CI/CD for App Service
description: Build and deploy a web application to Azure App Service using Azure Pipelines or GitHub Actions.

data.text: Azure App Service is a fully managed platform for hosting web apps, REST APIs, and mobile backends. CI/CD pipelines can automatically deploy code to App Service whenever changes are pushed.

data.title: Ways to Deploy to App Service
items: **Azure Pipelines** - Use the AzureWebApp task in a pipeline YAML
**Local Git** - Push directly to an App Service Git endpoint
**Zip Deploy** - Upload a ZIP package via REST API or CLI

data.title: Azure CLI - Zip Deploy
data.content: Deploy a ZIP package to an App Service app using the Kudu API.
data.code:
az webapp deploy --resource-group MyResourceGroup --name MyWebApp --src-path ./app.zip --type zip
az webapp log tail --resource-group MyResourceGroup --name MyWebApp

data.title: YAML - Azure Pipelines App Service Deployment
data.content: Deploy a .NET app to App Service using Azure Pipelines.
data.code:
- stage: Deploy
  jobs:
    - deployment: DeployWeb
      environment: 'production'
      pool:
        vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
      strategy:
        runOnce:
          deploy:
            steps:
              - task: AzureWebApp@1
                inputs:
                  azureSubscription: 'MyAzureConnection'
                  appType: 'webAppLinux'
                  appName: 'my-web-app'
                  package: '$(Build.ArtifactStagingDirectory)/**/*.zip'

data.title: Run From Package
data.text: For Linux App Service, enable WEBSITE_RUN_FROM_PACKAGE=1 to mount the ZIP directly. This gives faster cold starts and atomic deployments.

terms.definition: A deployment method that uploads a ZIP file containing your app to the Kudu service.
A deployment mode where the app runs directly from a mounted ZIP file, improving performance and reliability.
The deployment engine behind Azure App Service. Access it at https://<appname>.scm.azurewebsites.net.

data.title: Exercise: Deploy with Zip Deploy
data.description: Use Azure CLI to deploy a web app to App Service.
steps: Create an App Service plan and web app on Linux
Publish a .NET or Node.js app to a ZIP file
Verify the app is running by browsing to the URL
data.expectedOutcome: A running web app deployed via Zip Deploy with Run From Package enabled.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Azure Pipelines and GitHub Actions both support App Service deployment
Zip Deploy is the simplest and fastest way to deploy a ZIP package
Run From Package improves cold start time and prevents file lock issues
Use deployment slots to stage changes before swapping to production
data.takeaway: App Service supports multiple deployment methods. Zip Deploy with Run From Package is the recommended approach for production.
